fusions.name: Plunging Drizzle
fusions.desc: Drops a shot from above that deals 11 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, with a 60% chance of [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Cloudburst Mortar
fusions.desc: Lobs 6 shells that each deal 8 damage; every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Grey Curtain
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Slicker Reload
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
